review.notes: ProPublica confirms Spanish-speaking Unity Council of Alameda County Inc (EIN 94-1670490, 501(c)(3), Oakland), and unitycouncil.org confirms the Fruitvale base, programs, phone, general admin email and address; this fits an Oakland adult and career education MOU and space lease.
